SELECT EE.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, EE.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, EEA.DEAL_CUR_ACCT dealAcct, EEA.COR_CUR_ACCT corAcct, EE.COUNTER_ID counterId, EE.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, EE.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, (EE.ENTRUST_AMT-IFNULL(FINISH_AMT,0))/10000 prin, ED.TRADER trader, EEA.MATURE_YIELD*100 yield, EEA.TERM_TYPE termType, EEA.DEAL_MODE intType, EEA.BUSI_PS irsType FROM ETR_ENTRUST EE LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD EEA ON EE.ENTRUST_ID = EEA.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE ED ON ED.ENTRUST_ID = EE.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT ENTRUST_ID, SUM(FINISH_AMT) FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) FINISH_AMT ON FINISH_AMT.ENTRUST_ID = EE.ENTRUST_ID
EE.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
